L127@P6: 6. Standard Test Condition
L128@P6: 6.1. Environment Condition
L129@P6: Unless otherwise specified, all tests stated in this specification are conducted at temperature 25±2°C and humidity
L130@P6: under 65% RH.
L131@P6: 6.2. Measuring Equipment
L132@P6: (1) Amp-meter and volt-meter
L133@P6: The amp-meter and volt-meter should have an accuracy of the grade 0.5mA and 0.5mV or higher.
L134@P6: (2) Slide caliper
L135@P6: The slide caliper should have 0.01mm scale.
L136@P6: (3) Impedance meter
L137@P6: The impedance meter with AC 1 kHz should be used.

L142@P6: 7.2. Maximum Charge
L143@P6: Maximum charge means charging the cell CCCV with charge current 5.6A (1C), constant voltage 4.20V and 0.112A
L144@P6: cut-off in CV mode at 25°C.

L189@P8: 7.9. Status of the Cell as of Ex-factory
L190@P8: The cell should be shipped in 3.400V to 3.600V charging voltage range.
L191@P8: 8. Mechanical Characteristics
L192@P8: 8.1. Free Fall Test
L193@P8: Test method: Each fully charged cell is dropped three times from a height of 1.0m onto a concrete floor. The cells are
L194@P8: dropped so as to obtain impacts in random orientations. After the test, the cells shall be put on rest for 1h and then a visual
L195@P8: inspection shall be performed.
L196@P8: Criteria: No fire, no explosion.
L197@P8: Free fall test is according to the IEC62133 standard.
L198@P8: 8.2. Vibration Test
L199@P8: Test method: For X and Y axis with cylindrical cell 7Hz→200Hz→7Hz for 15min, repetition 12 times totally 3 hours,
L200@P8: the acceleration 1g during 7 to 18Hz, then amplitude 1.6mm and maximum 8g up to 200Hz.
L201@P8: Criteria: No fire, no explosion, no leakage, with less than 10% of OCV drop.
L202@P8: Vibration test is according to the UN38.3 standard.
L203@P8: 9. Safety
L204@P8: 9.1. Overcharge Test
L205@P8: Test method: Fully standard discharged cell is charged with 4.6V and 16.8A (3C) for 7h.
L206@P8: Criteria: No fire, no explosion.
L207@P8-9: 契约锁-EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential ProprietaryModel INR21700/58E Spec. No. PBRI-INR21700/58E-D06-01 Version No. B
L208@P9: EVE Confidential
L209@P9: 5 / 12
L210@P9: Overcharge test is according to the UL1642 standard.
L211@P9: 9.2. External Short-circuit Test
L212@P9: Test method: Fully standard charged cell is to be short-circuited by connecting the positive and negative terminals of
L213@P9: the cell with a circuit load having are resistance load of 80±20mΩ at 55±5°C. The cell remains on test for 24h or until the
L214@P9: surface temperature declines by 20% of the maximum temperature rise, whichever is the sooner.
L215@P9: Criteria: No fire, no explosion.
L216@P9: External short-circuit test is according to the IEC62133 standard.
L217@P9: 9.3. Forced Discharge Test
L218@P9: Test method: A discharged cell is subjected to a reverse charge at 5.6A (1C) for 90 min.
L219@P9: Criteria: No fire, no explosion.
L220@P9: Forced discharge test is according to the IEC62133 standard.
L221@P9: 9.4. Heating Test
L222@P9: Test method: To heat up the standard charged cell at heating rate 5°C per minute up to 130°C and keep the cell in
L223@P9: oven for 10 minutes.
L224@P9: Criteria: No fire, no explosion.
L225@P9: Heating test is according to the UL1642 standard.
L226@P9: 9.5. Low Pressure Test
L227@P9: Test method: Fully standard charged cell is to be stored at a pressure of 11.6 kPa or less for at least six hours at ambient
L228@P9: temperature.
L229@P9: Criteria: No fire, no explosion and no leakage with less than 10% of OCV drop.
L230@P9: Altitude Simulation test is according to the UN38.3 standard.

L232@P9: The cell warranty is one year since the date of delivery. The warranty period is subject to this EVE INR21700/58E

L236@P9: etc.
L237@P9: The cell has been damaged by clients’ abuse, misuse or inappropriate using (not follow the instruction list in this
L238@P9: specifications);
L239@P9: The cell has been damaged while the using condition exceed the limits of this specifications;
L240@P9-10: 契约锁-EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential ProprietaryModel INR21700/58E Spec. No. PBRI-INR21700/58E-D06-01 Version No. B

L243@P10: The cell has met the trouble while mating the electric circuit, cell pack and charger;
L244@P10: The cell has met the trouble while assembling after acceptance.
L245@P10: 11. Precautions and Safety Instructions
L246@P10: Abuse of Rechargeable Lithium-ion cells can cause damage to the cell and/or personal injury. Please read and observe
L247@P10: the standard cell precautions below before using.
L248@P10: Note 1. Customer shall contact and confirm with EVE in advance if intends to use the cell exceed the limitations
L249@P10: which has clarified within this specifications.
L250@P10: Note 2. EVE will take no responsibility for any accident that occurs when the cell is used under conditions other than
L251@P10: those described in this document.
L252@P10: Note 3. For the sake of safety assurance, if there are special requirements or special use scenarios for the design of
L253@P10: lithium-ion battery packs, related control systems and protection circuit settings, including but not limited to its using
L254@P10: condition, current, rapid charge requirements and etc, it is necessary to confirm in writing in advance with the EVE.
L255@P10: Otherwise, EVE will not be liable for cell failures or accidents caused by cells that are not suitable for the special
L256@P10: requirements or special usage scenarios.
L257@P10: 12. Guide for the Use of Lithium-ion Cells
L258@P10: 12.1.General
L259@P10: This chapter has been prepared to describe the appropriate cautions and prohibitions, which the customer should take
L260@P10: or employ when the customer uses and handles the lithium ion cell to be manufactured and supplied by EVE Energy CO.,
L261@P10: LTD., in order to obtain optimal performance and safety.
L262@P10: 12.2.Charging
L263@P10: 12.2.1. Charging current
L264@P10: Charging current shall be less than maximum charge current specified in the specification.
L265@P10: 12.2.2. Charging voltage
L266@P10: Charging shall be done by voltage less than that specified in the specification.
L267@P10: 12.2.3. Charging temperature
L268@P10: The cell shall be charged within a range of specified temperatures in the specification.
L269@P10: 12.2.4. Reverse charging
L270@P10: The cell shall be connected, confirming that its poles are correctly aligned. Inverse charging shall be strictly prohibited.
L271@P10: If the cell is connected improperly, it may be damaged. EVE is not liable for any damages resulting therefrom.
L272@P10: 12.3.Discharging
L273@P10-11: 契约锁-EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential ProprietaryModel INR21700/58E Spec. No. PBRI-INR21700/58E-D06-01 Version No. B
L274@P11: EVE Confidential
L275@P11: 7 / 12
L276@P11: 12.3.1. Discharging current
L277@P11: The cell shall be discharged continuously at less than maximum discharging current specified in the specification. In
L278@P11: case of the higher discharging current should be set, it shall be discussed with EVE.
L279@P11: 12.3.2. Discharging temperature
L280@P11: The cell shall be discharged within a range of temperatures specified in the specification. Otherwise, it may cause
L281@P11: loss of performance characteristics.
L282@P11: 12.3.3. Over-discharging
L283@P11: The system should equip with a device to prevent the cut-off voltage while discharging exceed the recommended
L284@P11: limits, the limits has been specified in this specification.
L285@P11: Over-discharging may lead to the loss of cell performance. Over-discharging may occur by self-discharging if the cell
L286@P11: is stored for a very long time without usage.
L287@P11: The charger should equip with a device to detect voltage of cell box and to determine recharging procedures.
L288@P11: 12.4.Storage
L289@P11: 12.4.1. Storage conditions
L290@P11: The cell should be stored within a range of temperatures specified in the specification. Otherwise, it may cause loss
L291@P11: of performance characteristics, leakage and/or rust.
L292@P11: 12.4.2. Long term storage
L293@P11: The cell should be used within a short period after charging because long-term storage may cause loss of performance
L294@P11: by self-discharging. If long-term storage is required the cell should be stored at lower voltage within a range specified in
L295@P11: this specification, as higher voltage storage may also lead to loss of performance.
L296@P11: 12.5.Cycle Life
L297@P11: 12.5.1. The cell can be charged & discharged repeatedly up to times with a certain level of capacity specified in
L298@P11: specification.
L299@P11: 12.5.2. Cycle life may be determined by conditions of charging, discharging, operating temperature and/or storage.
L300@P11: 12.6.Design of System
L301@P11: 12.6.1. Connection between the cell and the battery
L302@P11: To prevent the heat generation the cell should be connected with solder which shall be welded on the
L303@P11: connector(eg. cell cap or bottom), otherwise the component of the cell such as the separator and insulator may damaged.
L304@P11: 12.6.2. Positioning the battery in the system
L305@P11: The battery should be positioned as possible as far from heat sources and high temperature components. Otherwise,
L306@P11: it may cause loss of characteristics. The recommended spacing between the cells is more than 1mm.
L307@P11-12: 契约锁-EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential ProprietaryModel INR21700/58E Spec. No. PBRI-INR21700/58E-D06-01 Version No. B
L308@P12: EVE Confidential
L309@P12: 8 / 12
L310@P12: 12.6.3. Mechanical shock protection of the battery
L311@P12: The battery should be equipped with appropriate shock absorbers in the pack in order to minimize shock, which can
L312@P12: damage the cells. Otherwise, it may cause shape distortion, leakage, heat generation and/or rupture and/or open circuit.
L313@P12: 12.6.4. Short-circuit protection of the cell
L314@P12: The cell equips with an insulating sleeve to protect short-circuit which may occur during transportation, battery
L315@P12: assembly and/or system operation. If the cell sleeve is damaged by some cause such as outside impact, it may cause shortcircuit with some wiring inside the battery.
L316@P12: 12.6.5. Connection between the battery and charger/system
L317@P12: The battery should be designed to be connected only to the specified charger and system. A reverse connection of the
L318@P12: battery, even in the specified system, should be avoided by employing special battery design such as a special terminal.
L319@P12: 12.6.6. Pack design
L320@P12: The current consumption of the battery pack should be under 10uA at sleep mode. The system should be equipped
L321@P12: with a device to monitor each voltage of cell block to avoid cell imbalance which can cause damage to the cells.
L322@P12: The battery pack or system should have warning system such as over temperature, over voltage, over current, and so
L323@P12: on.
L324@P12: 12.7.Battery Pack Assembly
L325@P12: 12.7.1. Prohibition of usage of damaged cell
L326@P12: The cell should be inspected visually before battery assembly.
L327@P12: The cell should not be used if sleeve-damage, can-distortion and/or electrolyte-smell is detected.
L328@P12: 12.7.2. Terminals handing
L329@P12: Excessive force on the negative terminal should be avoided when external strip terminal is welded.
L330@P12: 12.7.3. Transportation
L331@P12: If the cell is necessary to be transported to such as the battery manufacturer, careful precautions should be taken to
L332@P12: avoid damage of cell.
L333@P12: 12.8.Others
L334@P12: 12.8.1. Disassembly
L335@P12: The cell should not be dismantled from the battery pack.
L336@P12: Internal short-circuit caused by disassembly may lead to heat generation and/or venting.
L337@P12: When the electrolyte with fresh water and seek medical advice.
L338@P12: 12.8.2. Short-circuiting
L339@P12: Short-circuit results in very high current which leads to heat generation.
L340@P12-13: 契约锁-EVE Energy CO., LTD Confidential ProprietaryModel INR21700/58E Spec. No. PBRI-INR21700/58E-D06-01 Version No. B
L341@P13: EVE Confidential
L342@P13: 9 / 12
L343@P13: An appropriate circuitry should be employed to protect accidental short-circuiting.
L344@P13: 12.8.3. Incineration
L345@P13: Incinerating and disposing of the cell in fire are strictly prohibited, because it may cause rupture and explosion.
L346@P13: 12.8.4. Immersion
L347@P13: Soaking the cell in water is strictly prohibited, because it may cause corrosion and leakage of components to be
L348@P13: damaged to functions.
L349@P13: 12.8.5. Mixing use
L350@P13: Different types of cell, or same types but different cell manufacturer shall not be used, which may lead to cell
L351@P13: imbalance, cell rupture or damage to system due to the different characteristics of cell.
L352@P13: 12.8.6. Battery exchange
L353@P13: Although the cell contains no environmentally hazardous component, such as lead or cadmium, the battery shall be
L354@P13: disposed according to the local regulations when it is disposed.
L355@P13: The cell should be disposed with a discharged state to avoid heat generation by an inadvertent short-circuit.
L356@P13: 12.8.7. Temperature measurement
L357@P13: The temperature monitoring system (K-type thermocouple) is recommended to be placed in the middle of the cell
L358@P13: (30mm~34mm up from the bottom of the cell), and the accuracy of the temperature monitoring system should be within
L359@P13: ±2℃.
L360@P13: 12.8.8. Caution
